Tennessee Prison Chief Resigns After Botched Christa Pike Execution

Frank Strada, the head of Tennessee's prison system, will resign following the failed execution of Christa Pike. Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections. Governor Bill Lee announced Strada's departure and stated that an independent review has been ordered to examine what went wrong. The incident has prompted calls for answers from both proponents and opponents of the death penalty. This was reportedly the state's second botched execution in 2026, leading Governor Lee to halt further executions for the remainder of the year.
